decisions.universe: Historical primary US common stocks on NYSE/Nasdaq/NYSE American including later delistings; index strategies additionally require contemporaneous index membership.
decisions.dataProcurement: Inspect existing data and scoped grants first; commercial options allowed for planning, purchases require explicit user authorization.
decisions.sameStockReplay: Preserve descriptive view; independently version fixed rule validation.
decisions.fiveYearWaitingPeriod: NOT_ADOPTED. History eligibility uses actual dependencies; prospective observation required only for unavailable inputs or independent confirmatory evidence.

proposals.rationale: Use all expected mature outcomes including excluded/censored/missing; separately enumerate immature labels. A high aggregate ratio cannot prove missing population completeness or eliminate concentrated delisting bias. Calibrate by time, listing and missingness before ratification.
Candidate economic policy only; require preregistered endpoint, costs, capacity and uncertainty. Do not transfer to different holding periods, portfolio CAGR or hit-rate effects.
Do not adopt fixed five years/20 episodes/20 quarters automatically. Determine information content, horizon overlap and precision by claimed regime; no substitutes for active regime gates.
Study-design target for a preregistered effect claim, not an implementation-completeness gate. Requires endpoint/MDE/cluster model and multiplicity plan before unsealing.
Interval overlap mechanically purged; embargo configurable. Any existing stricter horizon/cooldown policy remains active. A partition alone does not establish independent evidence.

contractDiscrepancies.resolution: Existing producer and status artifact unchanged to avoid weakening the stricter observed gate. Formal policy decision/migration and independently justified dependence unit remain required.
